body:
tara: Following the postmortem review, we need three concrete runbook changes: clearer triage steps, explicit paging targets, and a short "recurring-patterns" section. I'll coordinate owners.

wei: I can own the triage steps. Plan is to make it 6 bullet checks with exact PromQL and log commands.

ana: I'll take paging targets + escalation ladder. Need to confirm SRE rotation names and backup contacts.

sam: I'll add the recurring-patterns section and link the incident correlation queries. Also propose a short play to shift traffic to lower-context models on surge.

tara: Good. Can we assign tentative due dates? We want these in the runbook before the next quarter patch.

wei: Triage steps PR by 2026-04-02. I'll include a canonical commands snippet and a short smoke checklist.

ana: Escalation ladder + contact verification by 2026-04-04. I'll update on-call entries and set alert owners.

sam: Recurring-patterns doc + routing play by 2026-04-06. I'll add examples from the last 4 incidents.

oncall-bot: Linked postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/storage-surge-19611>. Tracker: INC-3247. Reminder: owners update due 2026-03-30.

tara: Wei, include these exact quick checks for first-responder. We want reproducible commands in the runbook.

wei: Drafting now. Quick commands to include:

```
# pods and recent evictions
kubectl get pods -n inference -l service=runtime -o wide
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l service=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=10m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"

# promql samples
sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m]))
avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])

# quick log extract for JSON logs
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=10m | jq -c 'select(.msg|test("evict|kv_warm"))'
```

ana: Add alert names please, so on-call can match pages. We should reference: `AlertCacheEvictionHigh` and `AlertKVWarmSlow`.

wei: Will add thresholds: `AlertCacheEvictionHigh` -> eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m, `AlertKVWarmSlow` -> kv_warmup_duration_seconds > 12s for 5m (tentative).

sam: For recurring-patterns, I'm adding a short decision tree: if evictions spike -> run triage steps -> if hit rate < 70% route to smaller-context model for 15m and notify infra-ops -> run canary.

tara: Can we also add a run command for generating a flamegraph of the runtime process? That helped in the last incident.

wei: Sure. Add this snippet:
```
# flamegraph (requires debug binary on node)
ssh node-123
sudo /opt/runtime/bin/collect-flame -p $(pgrep runtime) -o /tmp/flame.svg
scp node-123:/tmp/flame.svg .
```

ana: I'll map owners to escalation levels: L1 = inference-oncall, L2 = infra-sre, L3 = runtime-eng. Also adding contact phone for L2 backups.

oncall-bot: Reminder set: 2026-03-31 08:00 UTC to review PR diffs.

tara: Please make sure each PR references INC-3247 and adds the runbook section file path. I'll merge after a short review.

wei: Will open PR and add checklist entries: steps, commands, smoke test, and a small verification matrix.

sam: I'll prepare the routing playbook step as a simple rollback-able deployment action and a GH Action canary.

ana: One more ask: include a short FAQ entry under runbook: "When to escalate to L2 for eviction spikes" — I'll draft language for that.

tara: Ok final summary (owner -> task -> due):
- wei -> triage steps + commands + PR -> 2026-04-02
- nana -> escalation ladder + alert owners -> 2026-04-04
- sam -> recurring-patterns + routing play -> 2026-04-06

wei: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

ana: :thumbsup: I'll block time to confirm contacts.

oncall-bot: Actions logged to INC-3247. Postmortem link posted.

tara: Thanks all. This thread will be the canonical action list; ping me if blockers show up.
